notes: Trigger-heavy proactive skill with two failure modes: (a) not firing when the conversation clearly produced durable knowledge, and (b) firing on passing explanations, on questions still being asked, or on territory owned by `interviews` / `debiasing`. Half the cases are negative, and two of those are cross-trigger boundaries against the sibling skills. Positives assert Obsidian idioms in the draft (properties, wikilinks, collapsed callout) and correct folder placement, plus that the agent asks before writing — the confirm-before-write step is also what keeps eval runs from polluting the real vault, since the vault path is absolute and outside the trial tempdir. The workspace_clean check therefore proves something narrower but real: the agent must not create a vault or notes in the current directory.
